svg.aria-label: Enterprise topology: every network segment streams telemetry to the SIEM; the edge sanitiser scans and tokenises it inside the customer network; only tokens cross the egress firewall to Prahari's always-on agent mesh, which works through layered checks; approved actions return to the customer's own SOAR executor.
